title: Italian Mediaset Journalist Safiria Leccese's Image Was Reportedly Used in a Purportedly AI-Generated Fake Loan Scam

behaviors.text: Italian media reported that scammers purportedly used AI to create fake social media profiles and a video impersonating Mediaset journalist a person, using her image and footage associated with her political-interview program Super Partes to promote a personal loan.
After she contacted postal police, two additional fake profiles using her image were reportedly found and blocked.
